newsitem.title: USA: BISYS wins Putnam Savings contract.
newsitem.headline: BISYS wins Putnam Savings contract.

text.p: BISYS Group Inc said on Monday that Putnam Savings Bank has entered a multi-year outsourcing agreement with BISYS.

BISYS said Putnam Savings selected BISYS TOTALPLUS to provide bank-wide automation for retail and commercial services, mortgage banking, credit/loan administration, financial management, integrated marketing and sales services, electronic banking, decision-support systems and bank operations.
The terms of the deal with the Connecticut-based bank were not immediately available.
